name: portless
description: Replace port numbers with stable, named local URLs. For humans and agents.
one_liner: Gives your local development servers friendly web addresses (like myapp.local) instead of confusing port numbers, so both humans and AI coding agents can find the right running app.
buyer: Not a product end businesses buy — it's a free convenience tool for individual developers running multiple local projects at once.
business_use_cases: A developer running 5+ local projects uses it to stop mixing up which port belongs to which app.
A dev-tools company (like Vercel) uses adoption of tools like this to build goodwill and drive traffic to their paid platform.
An AI coding agent uses the stable URLs to reliably test the app it's working on across sessions.

money_ideas.idea: No direct monetization path — this is a marketing/goodwill tool for Vercel, not a standalone business.

steal_this: Nothing to build here as a business; if anything, use it yourself to speed up your own dev workflow.
